paragraphs.source_en:
Death
, thy servant, is at my door. He has crossed the unknown sea and brought thy call to my home.

units.source_en:
Death
, thy servant, is at my door.
He has crossed the unknown sea and brought thy call to my home.

paragraphs.source_en: The night is dark and my heart is fearful—yet I will take up the lamp, open my gates and bow to him my welcome. It is thy messenger who stands at my door.

units.source_en: The night is dark and my heart is fearful—yet I will take up the lamp, open my gates and bow to him my welcome.

ja.t: はおびえています。それでも

units.source_en: It is thy messenger who stands at my door.

ja.t: っているのは、あなたの

paragraphs.source_en: I will worship him with folded hands, and with tears. I will worship him placing at his feet the treasure of my heart.

units.source_en: I will worship him with folded hands, and with tears.
I will worship him placing at his feet the treasure of my heart.

paragraphs.source_en: He will go back with his errand done, leaving a dark shadow on my morning; and in my desolate home only my forlorn self will remain as my last offering to thee.

units.source_en: He will go back with his errand done, leaving a dark shadow on my morning; and in my desolate home only my forlorn self will remain as my last offering to thee.
